decisionsTitle: «a parcurs aproximativ N km», and «Clasament elite» without its «Loc» column (amending §1032, §1034)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-22, on the race's results:**

- «aici zic „a parcurs aproximativ”» — under Viorel Pălici's pace in «Clasament elite», whose 10,7 km was estimated, not measured. The line under a result with a runner's own «Distanța parcursă» reads «a parcurs aproximativ {km} km» («covered about {km} km»).
- «nu mai afișa coloana de „Loc” pentru elite» — the elites' table draws no «Loc» column: no header on a wide screen, no place at the left of a phone's three lines. The rows keep their order (by time, or by pace with the sort); the open table keeps its «Loc».

**Tests.** `tests/integration/results/public-section.test.ts`.
